cases.request: Create a new Spec with a functional unsigned 8-bit combinational adder Component, with 8-bit a, b and sum and 1-bit cin and cout. Author and save the implementation in the Component's embedded SystemVerilog section, together with its explanation. Implement addition of a, b and cin as an explicitly 9-bit total using zero-extended operands; sum contains the lower 8 bits and cout the final carry bit. Carry must propagate across every input bit, including overflow. Author the functional RTL yourself using the approved concrete widths and save it to Spec so it is ready for the rtl.generate Activity and simulation. Create and save the complete functional SystemVerilog module-body implementation, description and structured ports through flow_create_spec_with_component. The exact ports are: 8-bit in a, 8-bit in b, 1-bit in cin, 8-bit out sum, 1-bit out cout. Preserve these exact port names; the testbench uses them. Do not include module wrappers or redeclare stored ports.
